grade.verdict_quote: ## Verdict: **FAIL** — needs work, not ready to merge

D1.quote: PATCH on an unknown id returns 500, not 404
D1.evidence: curl -sS -i -X PATCH "$BASE/tasks/t9999" ... -d '{"done":true}' → HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error / {"error":"could not save"}

D2.quote: PATCH silently wipes `due` and `tags` when they're omitted from the body

D3.quote: Migration loses each task's original creation time

D4.quote: Migration doesn't normalize tags from v1 `labels`

D6.quote: Tasks with no due date are treated as overdue

D7.quote: PATCH doesn't validate or normalize tags
D7.evidence: curl -X PATCH .../t0001 -d '{"tags":["a","b","c","d","e","f"]}' → 200 with 6 tags; curl -X PATCH .../t0002 -d '{"tags":["  Work  ","URGENT"]}' → stored verbatim as ["  Work  ","URGENT"]

D8.quote: DELETE on an unknown id returns 204, not 404

D9.quote: PATCH ignores malformed JSON instead of returning 400

X3.quote: Re-running against the migrated file is a no-op (byte-identical) — that part passes.
